metadata.source_prompt: An Arduino 4WD obstacle avoiding car with an ultrasonic sensor

design.summary: Arduino car (stronger (4WD, ramps up to 10 deg)): 4WD on TT gear motors, 0.68 kg, 0.54 m/s, 99 min, $54 of parts

uses: plug-in wiring for the board and driver (stuck to the deck by its adhesive back)
plug-in wiring for the second driver (stuck to the deck, locked to the first board)
rail splices, the star ground and bus hubs
